info.about: Hamtaro: Ham-Hams Unite! is an action video game developed by Pax Softnica and Nintendo and published by for the Game Boy Color handheld video game console. It is based on the Hamtaro anime and features much of the same characters.
info.why: Nintendo published it in North America in April 2002, nearly a year after the Game Boy Advance launched, so it had a short cartridge run.
